hooks.command: BODY=$(perl -e 'alarm 2; local $/; print scalar <STDIN>' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$BODY" ] || BODY='{"hook_event_name":"PostToolUse"}'; D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ -f "$D/.tenet/context-hub.port" ] || { G=$(sed -n 's/^gitdir: //p' "$D/.git" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$G" ] && D="${G%/.git/worktrees/*}"; }; PORT=$(tr -dc 0-9 < "$D/.tenet/context-hub.port" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$PORT" ] && [ "$PORT" -le 65535 ]; then printf '%s' "$BODY" | curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST "http://localhost:$PORT/api/hooks" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
